A lottery is being run by the Salesian Fathers of St. John Bosco
in Calcutta for the sake of providing bread and clothing to hundreds
of boys to whom they impart a sound technical and social education
in their institutions in India. We solicit the co-operation of all good
people. It is a work which will no doubt draw God's blessings upon
those who so help. Over one lakh of Rupees is distributed in prizes
every time, and in addition a large commission is given to collectors.
Each ticket costs Rs. 2/-. (Rupees two only). The drawing date of
the event in course is on 20—12—51. All correspondence is to be
done in English and addressed to:-
